note: Persona-language locked cases, exactly one per implemented operation. Prompts avoid operation names and assertions pin deterministic synthetic evidence plus safety boundaries.

cases.onepager_bullet: Triage claims instantly to accelerate routing and reduce adjuster workloads
cases.prompt: Which incoming claim needs specialized handling first, and where should it be reviewed?

cases.onepager_bullet: Pre-prepare complex claim files to give adjusters ready-to-review summaries
cases.prompt: What is missing from Jennifer Liu’s theft file before I can evaluate it?

cases.onepager_bullet: Spot fraud indicators early to prevent exposure and protect claim payouts
cases.prompt: Which claim crosses the SIU review threshold, and does that prove fraud?

cases.onepager_bullet: Auto-adjudicate simple claims to shorten cycle times and improve consistency
cases.prompt: Show the policy-term estimates and state clearly whether any claim was approved or paid.

assertion_principle: Routing is proven by the expected tool; deterministic source output proves capability coverage. All records are synthetic and every consequential action remains behind human review.
